window_note: Rolling feed of deeply-researched picks (moneylines, totals, spreads, player/match props, and parlays) across the full confidence spectrum, refreshed hourly but only updated when something genuinely changed. Confidence tracks the specificity of the evidence. Only games that haven't started yet are included. Nothing here is ever a guaranteed outcome, however lopsided it looks.

settled.matchup: Benfica vs Celtic (Europa League, Draw No Bet)
reasoning: Bookmaker 1X2 prices of roughly Benfica 1.25 / draw 6.50 / Celtic 11.00 imply about 77% / 15% / 9% after removing margin; stripping the draw (Draw No Bet) puts Benfica near 89%.

Benfica won 2-0 at AC Milan on matchday one and have won nine of their last 10 matches in all competitions; Celtic lost 3-1 at home to Ferencvaros in their opener and only just snapped a three-game losing run with a 2-0 win over Motherwell.
Benfica have won all four previous European meetings with Celtic in Lisbon.

Situational: Benfica are without midfielder Enzo Barrenechea (knee), while Celtic are short at centre-back with Carter-Vickers a doubt. Neither absence changes the picture much. A draw is a push (stake refunded); no real DNB price was found, only the 1X2 prices.

settled.matchup: New York Jets vs New England Patriots
reasoning: Patriots are 7-7.5 point home favorites at about -325 to -350 (ESPN -325, FanDuel -350, down from a -375 opener), which is roughly 75-77% after removing the margin; models range from 73% (Dimers) to about 85-87% (Signal, numberFire).
New England (3-2) has won two straight including 44-17 over the Raiders, has covered 3-1-1 against the spread, and the Jets (2-3) have been swept by them in 8 of the last 10 years.

Held at 75% because Patriots running back TreVeyon Henderson is doubtful and left tackle Will Campbell is questionable, New England leads the league's Week 6 teams with 7 interceptions thrown, and the Jets pass offense rates 104.2 (4th in the NFL) with Geno Smith; Covers leans Jets +7.5. The line has also moved toward the Jets since opening. Kickoff 1:00 pm ET.

settled.matchup: Arizona Cardinals vs Los Angeles Rams

49ers are 7.5-point home favorites at -420 on FanDuel (Commanders +330), about 78-81% after removing the margin; Squawka's model gives San Francisco 83% and a 31-17 projection.

San Francisco is 5-0; Washington is 1-3-1 after a tie with the Giants, and its quarterback Marcus Mariota is listed as doubtful, with Charles Omenihu, Tyler Owens, Nick Cross and Stefon Diggs questionable.

settled.matchup: Manchester City vs AEK Athens (Champions League, Draw No Bet)
reasoning: bet365 has City to win at 1.14 (about 88% before removing margin) and Kalshi-linked pricing gives a City win about 84%; with the draw stripped out (Draw No Bet) that is roughly 93-94% for City. I found no real DNB price, only the match-winner price.

Manchester City are 7 from 7 in the Premier League after wins over Liverpool and Ipswich, though they lost 4-2 at PSG in their last Champions League game; AEK have never won away in the Champions League proper (5 draws, 11 losses) and are missing keeper Thomas Strakosha plus suspended players.

Held at 92% rather than the market's 93-94%: reports conflict on City's injuries (Semenyo and O'Reilly doubtful, Doku possibly out), Haaland may be rested, and Squawka expects a tight 1-0 type game. Sources also disagree on who is City's manager, so I did not rely on any manager-specific claim. A draw is a push (stake refunded). Kickoff 19:00Z (8:00 pm UK).
